briefdescription.para: Specialize the getType() method to always return an ArrayType, which reduces the amount of casting needed in parts of the compiler.
get() constructor - Return a constant with array type with an element count and element type matching the ArrayRef passed in.

detaileddescription.para: Note that this can return a ConstantAggregateZero object.

briefdescription.para: get() constructor - ArrayTy needs to be compatible with ArrayRef<ElementTy>.
getRaw() constructor - Return a constant with array type with an element count and element type matching the NumElements and ElementTy parameters passed in.

detaileddescription.para: Note that this can return a ConstantAggregateZero object. ElementTy must be one of i8/i16/i32/i64/half/bfloat/float/double. Data is the buffer containing the elements. Be careful to make sure Data uses the right endianness, the buffer will be used as-is.

briefdescription.para: getFP() constructors - Return a constant of array type with a float element type taken from argument ElementType, and count taken from / argument Elts.

detaileddescription.para: The amount of bits of the contained type must match the number of bits of the type contained in the passed in ArrayRef. (i.e. half or bfloat for 16bits, float for 32bits, double for 64bits) Note that this can return a ConstantAggregateZero object.

briefdescription.para: This method constructs a CDS and initializes it with a text string.

detaileddescription.para: The default behavior (AddNull==true) causes a null terminator to be placed at the end of the array (increasing the length of the string by one more than the StringRef would normally indicate. Pass AddNull=false to disable this behavior.
